categories.label: Won (final trophy from a fight)
categories.hint: First Witcher to gain their 4th Trophy via a Fight wins immediately.

categories.label: Trophies gained
categories.hint: Monster, Witcher-fight and Attribute (level 5) trophies; 4 needed.

winCondition: Players race to acquire 4 Trophies (killing monsters, winning fights against other Witchers, reaching level 5 in an Attribute). The first player to gain the final Trophy through a Fight wins immediately; gaining the 4th Trophy by Meditating does not end the game.

endCondition.description: First player to gain their 4th Trophy via a Fight ends the game immediately.

notes: family: objective-race. No points. Solo mode and 2-player Witcher-vs-Witcher rule changes not modelled. Source is the 1jour-1jeu hosted rulebook, a pre-release layout with unresolved page references; kept needsReview until checked against the final printed rulebook.
